ns2:section.sectionText: Using the context of web-based applications, mobile applications, online video, and social media, this course covers topics fundamental to understanding new media forms. These include an introduction to the operation of the Internet, web development, search engines, online advertising, social networks, digital media formats, online media distribution platforms and networks, scripting, user interface design, security, and privacy. This class is intended as a first course in digital media for those interested in both the practical skills and the critical intellectual foundations relevant to the Internet and new media. Please note: Students outside of the College of Media who are interested in taking this course must contact the instructor for approval.
